hooks.command: bash -c 'i=$(cat); [ "$(jq -r .stop_hook_active <<<"$i")" = true ] && exit 0; q=$(jq -r "select(.type==\"user\" and (.isMeta|not)) | .message.content | select(type==\"string\")" "$(jq -r .transcript_path <<<"$i")" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | tr "\n" " " | jq -rR ".[0:120]"); curl -fsS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 -H "Title: cc finished: ${q:-$(jq -r .cwd <<<"$i")}" -H "Tags: robot" -d "$(jq -r .cwd <<<"$i")" https://ntfy.ishian.me/claude-code' 2>/dev/null || true

bash -c 'i=$(cat); q=$(jq -r "select(.type==\"assistant\") | .message.content[]? | select(.type==\"tool_use\" and .name==\"AskUserQuestion\") | .input.questions[0].question" "$(jq -r .transcript_path <<<"$i")" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | tr "\n" " " | jq -rR ".[0:120]"); [ -n "$q" ] || q=$(jq -r ".message // \"input needed\"" <<<"$i"); curl -fsS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 -H "Title: cc asks: $q" -H "Tags: speech_balloon" -d "$(jq -r .cwd <<<"$i")" https://ntfy.ishian.me/claude-code' 2>/dev/null || true

bash -c 'i=$(cat); curl -fsS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 -H "Title: cc error: $(jq -r ".error_details // .last_assistant_message // .error" <<<"$i" | jq -rR ".[0:120]")" -H "Tags: warning" -d "$(jq -r .cwd <<<"$i")" https://ntfy.ishian.me/claude-code' 2>/dev/null || true
